policy: Each configured root must be a deliberately scoped standalone-avatar lane. Completeness requires an untruncated Git tree and explicit Unity humanoid/avatar importer evidence for every FBX in the root.

evidence.note: The original project team transferred the Axoquarium 3D models and code to the community.
The BaseModel subtree is the public Unity lane containing standalone Axolittles character FBXs and their importer metadata.
